gripOrHq.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Project Consultants
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Vacuum Link
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.

heapOrArchives.title: Roving Submarine
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: ACME Savings and Loan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. For the remainder of the game, pay [1] at the end of each of your turns, or lose the game. You can remove this effect, and score 1 agenda point, by taking an action to pay [12].

heapOrArchives.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Junkyard BBS
discardCards.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

discardCards.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
discardCards.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

discardCards.title: R&D Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: Rigged Investments
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Deep Thought
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

discardCards.title: Short-Term Contract
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

discardCards.title: Rigged Investments
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
rig.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

rig.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
rig.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.
